name: Open Locks
body:
Rules Index | GM Screen
Pathfinder Unchained / Consolidated Skills / Finesse (Dex; Armor Check Penalty; Trained Only)

Open Locks
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 58
The DC for opening a lock depends on the lock’s quality.

Lock Quality Finesse DC
Simple 20
Average 25
Good 30
Superior 40
Lacking thieves' tools +10

Action: Full-round.

Try Again: Yes.
